name: Claude Usage Observer
description: On request, reports your live usage figures from the snapshot the Ghola status line writes: the 5-hour rolling-window percentage and the current context-window usage. It no longer estimates your subscription plan - that estimate divided session tokens by the 5-hour percentage, and as of Claude Code v2.1.132 the token figure is the size of the CURRENT context window rather than a session total, which makes the implied quota shrink as quota is spent. TPM will report the figures and tell you plainly that they do not identify a plan. Speaks only when asked.

planBands.label: Plan Bands (unused - plan estimation retired)
planBands.description: NO LONGER READ - editing these bands changes nothing. They were matched against an implied 5-hour token quota computed as session_tokens / (5h percent / 100), and that computation is gone: as of Claude Code v2.1.132 the token figure is the size of the current context window, not a cumulative session total, so the implied quota falls as quota is actually spent and the error grows with session length. The harness payload exposes no cumulative session token count to substitute, so there is nothing left to match a band against. The setting is kept rather than deleted so an existing saved value is not orphaned; whether to drop it is the operator's call. If you tell TPM your real plan it will use that for the session - as something you said, not something Ghola measured.
